```{r}
# ============================================================
#  DADA2 Pipeline - Full 16S rRNA Amplicon Workflow
#  Designed for RStudio | eman mamdouh
#  Input: Paired-end FASTQ files from Mothur pre-processing
# ============================================================

# ── 0. Install / Load Packages ─────────────────────────────
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")
# BiocManager::install("dada2")       # Uncomment first run
# BiocManager::install("phyloseq")    # Uncomment first run
# install.packages("ggplot2")         # Uncomment first run
BiocManager::install("SRAdb")
library(dada2)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(SRAdb)
packageVersion("dada2")   # Confirm version (≥1.26 recommended)

# ── 1. Set Paths ───────────────────────────────────────────
path <- "/Users/pc/Desktop/New folder (3)/70_ Coral Sampls/"
# List files to confirm they are visible
list.files(path)

#url_R1 <- "https://ebi.ac.uk"
#url_R2 <- "https://ebi.ac.uk"

#download.file(url_R1, destfile = paste0(path, "SRR8470289_R1.fastq.gz"), mode = "wb")
#download.file(url_R2, destfile = paste0(path, "SRR8470289_R2.fastq.gz"), mode = "wb")


# ── 2. Sort and Match Forward & Reverse Reads ──────────────
# Adjust pattern to match your file naming convention:
# Common patterns: *_R1_001.fastq.gz  |  *_R1.fastq.gz  |  *_1.fastq
fnFs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern = "forward", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE))
fnRs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern = "reverse", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE))

# Extract sample names (strip path + suffix)
#sample.names <- sub("forward.fastqsanger", "", basename(fnFs))
#sample.names

sample.names <- basename(dirname(fnFs))
sample.names

# Sanity check: forward and reverse files must match in number
stopifnot(length(fnFs) == length(fnRs))

# ── 3. Visualize Quality Profiles ──────────────────────────
# Plot first 2 samples — inspect before choosing truncLen values
plotQualityProfile(fnFs[1:2])   # Forward reads
plotQualityProfile(fnRs[1:2])   # Reverse reads

# ── 4. Filter and Trim ─────────────────────────────────────
filtFs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_F_filt.fastq.gz"))
filtRs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_R_filt.fastq.gz"))
names(filtFs) <- sample.names
names(filtRs) <- sample.names

# ▸ Adjust truncLen based on quality plots above
# ▸ For V3-V4 region (Illumina 2×250): truncLen=c(250,200) is typical
# ▸ For V4 region (Illumina 2×150): truncLen=c(150,130) is typical
out <- filterAndTrim(
  fnFs, filtFs,
  fnRs, filtRs,
  truncLen    = c(240, 200),   # ← ADJUST based on quality plots
  maxN        = 0,             # No Ns allowed in DADA2
  maxEE       = c(2, 2),       # Max expected errors per read
  truncQ      = 2,
  rm.phix     = TRUE,
  compress    = TRUE,
  multithread = TRUE           # Set FALSE on Windows
)

print(out)  # Check reads passing filter (aim for >70% retention)

# Remove samples with zero reads after filtering
filtFs <- filtFs[file.exists(filtFs)]
filtRs <- filtRs[file.exists(filtRs)]
sample.names <- names(filtFs)

# ── 5. Learn Error Rates ────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(100)
errF <- learnErrors(filtFs, multithread = TRUE)
errR <- learnErrors(filtRs, multithread = TRUE)

# Visualize error rates — modeled (black line) should fit observed (points)
plotErrors(errF, nominalQ = TRUE)
plotErrors(errR, nominalQ = TRUE)

# ── 6. Dereplicate Reads ────────────────────────────────────
derepFs <- derepFastq(filtFs)
derepRs <- derepFastq(filtRs)
names(derepFs) <- sample.names
names(derepRs) <- sample.names

# ── 7. Sample Inference (DADA2 Core) ───────────────────────
dadaFs <- dada(derepFs, err = errF, multithread = TRUE, pool = "pseudo")
dadaRs <- dada(derepRs, err = errR, multithread = TRUE, pool = "pseudo")

# Inspect one sample
dadaFs[[1]]

# ── 8. Merge Paired Reads ───────────────────────────────────
mergers <- mergePairs(
  dadaFs, derepFs,
  dadaRs, derepRs,
  minOverlap  = 12,    # Minimum overlap between F and R reads
  maxMismatch = 0,     # No mismatches in overlap region
  verbose     = TRUE
)

# Inspect merger result for first sample
head(mergers[[1]])

# ── 9. Build Sequence Table (ASV Table) ─────────────────────
seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)
dim(seqtab)  # rows = samples, columns = ASVs

# Inspect length distribution of merged sequences
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab)))
# ▸ For V1-V2: expected amplicon ~330-350 bp


# ── 10. Remove Chimeras ─────────────────────────────────────
seqtab.nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(
  seqtab,
  method      = "consensus",
  multithread = TRUE,
  verbose     = TRUE
)

dim(seqtab.nochim)

# Fraction of reads retained after chimera removal (should be >80%)
cat("Fraction of reads retained:", sum(seqtab.nochim) / sum(seqtab), "\n")

# ── 11. Track Reads Through Pipeline ───────────────────────
getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))

track <- cbind(
  out[rownames(out) %in% paste0(sample.names, ".fastqsanger"), ],
  sapply(dadaFs,  getN),
  sapply(dadaRs,  getN),
  sapply(mergers, getN),
  rowSums(seqtab.nochim)
)

colnames(track) <- c("input", "filtered", "denoisedF", "denoisedR", "merged", "nonchim")
rownames(track) <- sample.names
print(track)

# Save tracking table
write.csv(as.data.frame(track),
          file = file.path(path, "read_tracking.csv"))

# ── 12. Assign Taxonomy ─────────────────────────────────────
# Download Silva database from: https://zenodo.org/record/4587955
# Files needed:
#   silva_nr99_v138.1_train_set.fa.gz       (genus level)
#   silva_species_assignment_v138.1.fa.gz   (species level)

taxa.db  <- "/Users/pc/Desktop/bio course/Metagenomic/project fils/silva_nr99_v138.1_train_set.fa.gz"       # ← UPDATE path
species.db <- "/Users/pc/Desktop/bio course/Metagenomic/project fils/silva_species_assignment_v138.1.fa.gz" # ← UPDATE path

taxa <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim, taxa.db, multithread = TRUE)
taxa <- addSpecies(taxa, species.db)

# Preview taxonomy table
taxa.print <- taxa
rownames(taxa.print) <- NULL
head(taxa.print)

# ── 13. Build Phyloseq Object ───────────────────────────────
# Optional: load metadata table (samples × variables)
# metadata <- read.csv(file.path(path, "metadata.csv"), row.names = 1)

ps <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(seqtab.nochim, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  # sample_data(metadata),    # Uncomment if metadata is ready
  tax_table(taxa)
)

ps   # Print summary

# Rename ASVs to short IDs (ASV1, ASV2, ...) for readability
dna <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(taxa_names(ps))
names(dna) <- paste0("ASV", seq_along(dna))
ps  <- merge_phyloseq(ps, dna)
taxa_names(ps) <- paste0("ASV", seq_along(taxa_names(ps)))
ps

# ── 14. Save Outputs ───────────────────────────────────────
saveRDS(seqtab.nochim,
        file.path(path, "seqtab_nochim.rds"))
saveRDS(taxa,
        file.path(path, "taxonomy.rds"))
saveRDS(ps,
        file.path(path, "phyloseq_object.rds"))

write.csv(as.data.frame(seqtab.nochim),
          file.path(path, "ASV_table.csv"))
write.csv(as.data.frame(taxa),
          file.path(path, "taxonomy_table.csv"))

#cat("\n✅ DADA2 pipeline complete! Outputs saved to:",)
path =("/Users/pc/Desktop/New folder (3)/")


# ── 15. Quick Diversity Visualization (Optional) ────────────
# Alpha diversity
plot_richness(ps, measures = c("Shannon", "Simpson")) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Alpha Diversity")

# Ordination (Bray-Curtis)
ord <- ordinate(ps, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")
plot_ordination(ps, ord, type = "samples") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Beta Diversity - PCoA (Bray-Curtis)")
```
